verbatim_quote.original: A1 scope: require the planning turn to emit one auditable line — `Brainstorm: required | not required — <reason>` — with the rule that a task which is cross-disciplinary AND hard to reverse requires the full seven-seat report. The reason is recorded in the execution log. A matching sentence goes in the Hands planning gate in `agents/cognitive-executor.md` (that file is NOT a prompt-build input, so no rebuild is owed for it).

extracted_decision.summary: Require auditable brainstorm trigger line and hard rule for cross-disciplinary + hard-to-reverse tasks; add matching executor gate.
extracted_decision.rationale: Make the brainstorming trigger auditable and prevent automatic brainstorming.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Adds one-line requirement to planning turns but improves auditability and control.
